final_checks.synthetic_method: Test-only validator checks hand-authored transaction/cancellation/replay observations and deliberately contradictory traces. It is an executable specification, not an implementation of Firestore, claim, cancellation, storage or retries. Passing proves examples meet these test assertions; it does not prove production behavior.

Cancellation before/after the sample provider start preserves inclusion; stale next call, late saved result and history rewrite rejected.
Aborted callback context cannot escape into the committed attempt; failed commit cannot publish a snapshot.
Restart after claim or lost acknowledgement after original receipt uses the same run and records no new generation.
All-excluded/no-run distinguished from incomplete, missing, duplicate and over-five candidate sets.
Verified legacy absence, unclaimed omission, denied/read-error/bad-binding/new-claim-missing cases distinguished; scope/event/run mismatches rejected.
